description: Open a usage/budget meter recorded in SaSame's append-only ledger. Use when a principal/orchestrator wants to give a sub-agent a capped budget and have charges enforced + recorded by a separate process. SaSame holds NO funds and is NOT a payment processor: it timestamps and ed25519-signs the envelope with its published public key, so the accounting is offline-verifiable. Returns a meter_id + a signed receipt (verify the signature with trust_pubkey).

budget.description: Budget cap in your own units (e.g. USDC, tokens, calls). Charges beyond this are rejected.

owner_label.description: Who owns this budget (self-claimed label, unverified)

name: meter_open
